content.what_it_is: A parallel CPU Makefile for FUNWAVE-TVD/FUNWAVE-GPU sources. It builds funwave_paral with mpif90, single precision, PARALLEL, ZALPHA, and PGI macros, and -O2 optimization; it preprocesses .F files, compiles and links the standard module/main source groups, and provides tarfile, clean, and clobber targets (lines 1-113).
